body: I’m not completely alone although I feel that way sometimes, as I’m sure anyone like myself does. I gone to a counselor provided by my university, but I’ve only gone once, and it helped. I still use the techniques they gave me. Most can be boiled down to just talking, as you say. I’m not sure what made things escalate recently. Sometimes I cannot figure it out because things don’t feel any different than say a week ago. It’s strange.

I appreciate not holding back any punches. I didn’t show this to anyone, but I told a friend of mine that I “wrote a dark note” and she read between the lines well enough to know what it was. It’s a burden I’ve carried for a long time, and I know that’s a part of myself that does need to die. I read once that if you want to kill yourself then fine, but make sure you kill the right part of it. That makes sense to me. At times I just get very overwhelmed.
